annotations.title: Buy one DiarioBitcoin article's full text

description: PAID: the full text of one DiarioBitcoin article, for a few cents in USDC or USDT on Solana mainnet, paid per call with x402 (no account or API key). Same arguments as get_article. Without payment it returns an x402 PaymentRequired (isError=true; accepts lists amount in atomic units, asset mint, payTo and extra.feePayer, which pays the network fee). Pay by calling again with a PaymentPayload in _meta["x402/payment"] (scheme exact: a transaction with SetComputeUnitLimit, SetComputeUnitPrice, one TransferChecked to payTo's token account, then one Memo whose data is extra.memo and nothing else, signed by your wallet, extra.feePayer as fee payer). The result is the get_article envelope with body_kind="full" and the receipt in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Sponsored articles and press releases are not sold. Cannot pay? Use get_article (excerpt and link).

slug.description: Article slug (the `slug` of a `get_news` item; never a URL).
